result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees. While the environment is low-speed and residential, it lacks marked pedestrian crossings, traffic calming, and physical buffers between the walkway and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the narrow street create significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs where vehicles are parked

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crossing points visible, forcing pedestrians to cross between parked cars without designated right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to increase pedestrian visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a continuous sidewalk that is in poor physical condition, featuring significant cracking and a large hole. There is no buffer between the walkway and the roadway, and no pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure like lighting or crossings is visible in this mid-block view.

hazards.name: Damaged Sidewalk
hazards.description: A large hole and significant cracking in the concrete sidewalk create a tripping hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, center-left on the sidewalk near the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no physical separation or buffer zone, increasing risk from passing vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible length of the sidewalk-road interface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Patch or replace the damaged sections of the concrete sidewalk to ensure a level and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the walkway on the right is notably narrow and lacks a buffer from traffic. The environment lacks traffic calming measures and marked crossings, with dense on-street parking potentially obstructing sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses built directly to the sidewalk edge. Large mature trees significantly narrow the effective walking width and have caused some unevenness in the pavement, though the street appears to have low traffic volume.

hazards.name: Narrowed walkway
hazards.description: Large tree trunks occupy a significant portion of the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into a narrow path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left and right where large trees are located on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Trip hazards
hazards.description: Uneven pavement and accumulated leaf litter near tree roots create a risk of falls.
hazards.location_in_image: Base of the trees where roots meet the pavement

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: The combination of large trees and parked vehicles obscures the view between the sidewalk and the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where trees and parked cars are situated

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or widen the sidewalk into the parking lane to provide a consistent clear path around trees.

interventions.title: Pavement repair
interventions.description: Level the sidewalk using root-friendly materials to eliminate trip hazards while preserving the tree canopy.

interventions.title: Improved lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility under the dense tree canopy.
